Gym etiquette every man
should follow

1. Re-rack your weights

Nobody is your mom here.

2. Wipe the bench

Every time. No exceptions.

3. Don't stand in front of
the dumbbell rack

4. Ask before you jump in

"How many sets left?"

5. Use your rest time well

One short lesson between sets.
